scores.evidence: On desktop every table and code block is readable. At 390 px the s1-table and s3-table cut off their right column mid-sentence (mobile-jp-04, -10, -11), and s2-code, s3-code and p1-model cut off long lines (mobile-jp-06, -10, -20).
textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices, and every screen has a heading, table, code, steps or a check. Inline checks q1–q4 come between sections, so there is no wall of text.

The lesson is Japanese only, and no English UI or content leaks into the JP screenshots. The link text is specific (「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」 in s3-mode), and the code blocks and tables have filenames and captions.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the second column runs past the card edge. The text breaks off mid-sentence (「調べもの・レビュー。設」, 「別々の変更を同時に進め」), and the header 「向いている作業と、気をつけること」 is cut off. s4-table, which has short headers, fits.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the headers to 「方法」 and 「向く作業・注意点」, and put the owner in the cell (for example 「[[サブエージェント]]（Claude）」 as is). Or replace the table with three short definition-style rows so the second column wraps inside 358 px.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the right column of the flags table is cut off: the header 「役割と、付けないとどうなるか」 and the cell texts end mid-word (「確認が要る操作を聞かずに」, 「付けないと、必要な操作」). The nowrap flag chips such as `--permission-mode` take up the width.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the second header to 「役割／付けないと」. Split each cell into two short sentences of about 20 chars, or turn the table into a list of five flag + explanation items so nothing has to fit side by side at 390 px.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the Japanese trailing comments run off the code block: line 1 「…最初のコミットを用意する」, line 5 「# 未追跡に出さない」, line 8 「# 一度起動して…終了する」 and line 13 「（cc-practice-09 で実行）」 are cut off.
mustFix.fix: Move the trailing comments onto their own lines above the command, and keep each comment to 16 JP chars or fewer (for example 「# 練習用リポジトリを作る」, 「# 信頼の確認に答えて終了」).

mustFix.issue: At 390 px line 2 (the prompt string 「npm run lint の警告をファイルごとに数えてください。」) and line 3 (`--allowedTools "Bash(npm run lint *)"`) are cut off at the right edge.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the prompt string to about 14 JP chars (for example "lint の警告を数えて"). Or split it across two lines, so each line stays within about 34 monospace columns.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px lines 5 and 8 of the model answer are cut off. The closing brace of {"status": "error", "reason": "<理由>"} disappears, so the JSON shape looks incomplete.
mustFix.fix: Break line 8 into two lines ({"status": "error", / "reason": "<理由>"}), and shorten line 5 (for example 「各要素は name・file・error。」).

niceToHave: reader: inline code breaks mid-token on mobile: `--bare` splits into 「--」/「bare」 in the p-run step (mobile-jp-18) and in summary-points (mobile-jp-29), and `--worktree` splits in ex-feature (mobile-jp-07). Inline code should not break at the hyphen.
reader: the lesson subtitle breaks 「claude -」/「p」 across lines on mobile (mobile-jp-01). The author could also reword it so `claude -p` sits mid-line.
reader: the desktop JP measure has a median of 41 chars per line (max 51) against the 30–40 target (metrics.json charsPerLine).
reader: there is no scroll cue on wide tables and code blocks at 390 px (known).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (known).
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (known); the per-screen PNGs cover the whole lesson.
summary: The screenshots show lessonHash sha256:d960aa01a4d029e9 (copied from metrics.json). There are no hard failures (no overflowX, console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors), no text-only screens and no personal data on any screen. Desktop renders cleanly. The most important fix is mobile at 390 px: s1-table and s3-table cut off their right column mid-sentence, and s2-code, s3-code and p1-model cut off long lines. Shorter headers and cells, and comments on their own lines, would fix this.
